results.title: Fundivi Joins Business Loan Fraud Prevention Effort And Highlights Lender Ratings
results.description: The October 12 announcement outlines fundivi's support for fraud reporting and education, alongside recognition in three publishers' lender ratings. Brooklyn, New York, October 14, 2026 -- Fundivi announced on October 12, 2026, that it has joined an industry effort against business loan fraud, supporting report verification and helping business owners recognize and report suspected scams. The announcement follows recognition in publisher-specific lender ratings: Business Loans IQ lists fundivi as its Editor's Pick with a score of 4.8 out of 5; Best Rated Business Loans lists it as its number-one verified lender with a rating of 4.9; and Compare Business Loans Online ranks it first with a score of 4.8 out of 5. fundivi provides working capital, term loans, revenue-based financing and equipment financing to businesses across the United States, delivering capital directly and through vetted third-party funding providers. As part of its participation in the fraud-prevention effort, fundivi supports report verification by sharing knowledge about legitimate funding processes and the warning signs associated with fraudulent offers. The company helps business owners understand written terms, application procedures and decision timelines, and encourages anyone who suspects they have been targeted by a scam to report their experience. Its resource, Fighting Business Loan Scams as an Industry, addresses upfront-payment requests, pressure to act immediately and the importance of independently confirming a lender's contact details. "We help business owners understand the funding process, recognize warning signs and report suspected fraud with supporting records," said Steven Kay, Chief of Operation at fundivi. "Business owners who know what a legitimate offer looks like are better positioned to avoid fraudulent ones." The guidance recommends preserving emails, text messages, contracts, receipts, website screenshots and payment records when reporting suspected fraud. These records help make reports verifiable and connect separate complaints involving the same operator. Business owners researching information about fundivi can also review how its funding approach combines application assessment with direct funding and access to vetted providers. Funding offers from fundivi are subject to prequalification and underwriting criteria, and rates, terms and conditions vary by borrower qualifications. The company does not guarantee approval or specific terms for any applicant. results.title: 'GTA VI' Is Reportedly Getting a PC Release in Q1 2027
results.description: Summary According to a new report, Grand Theft Auto 6 is targeting a first-quarter 2027 launch on PCThe accelerated timeline marks a significantly shorter console-to-PC release gap than the previous installmentRockstar Games' recent PC launcher updates suggest infrastructure preparation for the game's massive multiplayer ecosystem The wait for the PC port of Grand Theft Auto VI might be significantly shorter than history suggests. According to a new report from GamesBeat citing sources familiar with the matter, Rockstar Games is slated to drop the PC version of the blockbuster title in the first quarter of 2027. If the timeline holds, PC players could be running the game by the end of March 2027. This reported release window lands just a few months after the title's official console debut, which is locked in for November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. Rockstar Games is currently accepting pre-orders for those initial console versions. A Q1 2027 rollout represents a massive shift in the developer's standard playbook, aggressively closing the historically wide gap between its console and PC releases. When the studio launched Grand Theft Auto 5 on the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 on September 17, 2013, the title did not make its way to PC until April 2015. Grand Theft Auto 6 is already viewed as a massive, market-defining industry event, prompting competing publishers to completely clear out their fall 2026 release schedules to avoid going head-to-head with its console debut. If the PC port drops in early 2027, it will land in the middle of a heavily packed first-quarter release slate that currently features heavyweight titles including Stranger Than Heaven, Metroid Ravenous, Until Dawn 2, Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, God of War Laufey and Fable. Beyond the base game, the fast-tracked PC timeline could heavily dictate how the franchise handles its wildly lucrative multiplayer environment. Rockstar has remained notoriously quiet on exactly when it will officially add an online multiplayer mode to Grand Theft Auto 6, though Twitch CEO Dan Clancy recently claimed that the online component will launch next year. The highly popular roleplaying mods that kept the previous game culturally dominant for a decade are strictly PC-only. Recently, Rockstar directly integrated a Grand Theft Auto 5 roleplaying option into its PC launcher, three years after the studio acquired FiveM, the team behind the roleplaying server company. This strategic move to bake roleplaying tools directly into its PC ecosystem suggests that the company is actively preparing its infrastructure ahead of switching on multiplayer features for the new PC port.
